messages:
marta: Observed weird token budget oscillations on pool-3 after the multi-variant routing tweak. Throughput stayed same but latency tail jumped.
priyanka: Can you paste the perf profile? KV hitrate? Any kernel fallbacks?
marta: profile snippet:
```
batcher: continuous_v2
token_budget_target: 32
compat_sets: dynamic_by_variant
observed_kv_hitrate: 0.68 -> 0.45 after routing
avg_batch_size: 5.1 -> 3.2
kernel: selected=fp16_fast, fallback=fp32_matmul (more often)
```
matt: that drop in avg_batch_size screams fragmentation — compatset boundaries are causing smaller coalesced batches. KV cache drop matches.
sara: also seeing more kernel fallbacks in logs. likely because shorter sequences change kernel selection heuristics (padding ratios)
dong: Curious if prefetching keys for predicted variants would help. We have a short experiment where prefetch for the top-2 variants improved kv_hitrate by ~8%.
priyanka: Proposal: lower token_budget_target to 24 for pool-3 as temporary mitigation; change queue policy to prefer same-compat coalescing for 50ms window; add aggressive kv-prefetch for top-2 variants.
marta: I ran an offline re-sim: token_target=24 -> avg_batch_size 4.1, tail latency reduced 18%, kv_hitrate up to 0.57. But CPU scheduling cost increased slightly.
matt: Patch suggestion:
```yaml
queue_policy:
  name: compat_coalesce
  max_wait_ms: 50
  prefer_local_compat: true
token_budget_target: 24
kv_prefetch:
  enabled: true
  top_k_variants: 2
  prefetch_timeout_ms: 10
```
priyanka: canary this on pool-3 small subset? if good we roll to other pools. also add range query to kernel selector to bias towards fp16_fast for seq_len < 256.
deploy-bot: Canary started on pool-3 (2/32 nodes). monitor: /dash/pool-3/canary-2223456789
sara: added observability: token_budget per-queue, compatset fragmentation metric, kernel-fallback-rate alert.
marta: thanks — action items: pr with queue_policy + token change (matt), kv-prefetch probe (dong), canary watch (priyanka). follow-up in 2h.
priyanka: noted. :thumbsup:
